description: MainActivity.java is the main activity class for an Android wearable app that manages calendar events synchronization with a paired device via Google Play Services Wearable DataApi. It handles permissions, connection to GoogleApiClient, and user interactions to get or delete calendar-related data.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the wearable app, manages GoogleApiClient connection, permission handling, and UI interactions for syncing or deleting calendar data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and builds the GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Connects the GoogleApiClient when the activity starts.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Disconnects the GoogleApiClient when the activity stops.

methods.name: onGetEventsClicked
methods.description: Handles user action to retrieve calendar events, checks permissions, and initiates data push.

methods.name: requestCalendarAndContactPermissions
methods.description: Requests calendar and contacts permissions, providing rationale if necessary.

methods.name: pushCalendarToWear
methods.description: Starts a service to query and push calendar data to the wearable device.

methods.name: onDeleteEventsClicked
methods.description: Handles user action to delete calendar data items from the wearable device.

methods.name: deleteDataItems
methods.description: Iterates over data items and deletes them using GoogleApiClient and DataApi.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Callback for suspension of GoogleApiClient connection.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Callback for failed GoogleApiClient connection attempt, tries resolution if possible.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of resolution attempts for Google Play services errors.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of runtime permission requests, proceeds with calendar data fetching if granted.

methods.name: appendLog
methods.description: Appends a string message to the log TextView and scrolls to the bottom.
